correctness.rationale: The even-subset quotient is an exact nondegenerate symplectic model of hyperelliptic genus-four 2-torsion in odd characteristic. All 200787 binary 4-planes were enumerated in unique RREF; exactly 2295 are totally isotropic and the independently constructed orthogonal-extension set agrees element-for-element. Every one of 42 induced Frobenius permutations was fully traversed; all rows and 945/1350 components were checked, with the 16-torsion/151-versus-39 example certified using five irreducible quadratics over F5. The finite calculation exhausts a fixed group action uniformly for every finite field; it is not empirical extrapolation.

value.rationale: An intrinsic complete finite-étale kernel-descent invariant of every odd-characteristic hyperelliptic genus-four Jacobian is determined across all 42 possible branch splitting types. The 945/1350 arithmetic refinement distinguishes geometrically natural components. Explicit F5 curves have the same 16 rational two-torsion elements but different numbers of rational maximal polarized-isogeny kernels, 151 versus 39, so this finite classification provides genuine arithmetic information not recoverable from the simplest torsion statistic. No assertion is made about targets being Jacobians.
